Factions.Name: Lanayru Province
Factions.History: Originally established as a small vassal state through the union of Hylian and Zora marriages, Lanayru Province quickly grew to become an economic juggernaut that financially rivals the larger empires of the world. The bountiful resources of their homeland allow for rapid wealth, but make the small and young nation a prime target for constant invasions at the hands of greedy and hungry forces.

Heroes.Name: Aydia Dorephan
Heroes.History: Aydia was a long serving Marshal in Lanayru's army. She is almost entirely responsible for the Province's conscription program and without it the nation would have likely fallen from a lack of military force by now. She has perhaps participated in more battles than any other Zora of the north, and bears scars from her numerous engagements.

Heroes.Name: Duke Dorephan
Heroes.History: A politcally powerful lord of the Zora who has wormed his way into running most of Lanayru. He has long been friends of King De Bon, but in secret he has been massing power under the Zora King's nose in hopes of putting the Dorephan family on the throne. The divorce of De Bon and Rutela broke apart his initial plans, but has since provided him amble opprotunity to use the schism and take over Lanayru Province.

Heroes.Name: Mipha Dorephan
Heroes.History: The only daughter of Duke Dorephan and Aydia, Mipha was encouraged from a young age to follow her in her mother's footsteps and uphold her family's military lineage. Despite some talent with pole-arms, Mipha feels her place is not in taking life, but healing it.

Heroes.Name: Prince Ralis
Heroes.History: The Son of King De Bon and Queen Rutela, Ralis was born shortly after the royal divorce. For most of his life he lacked a father figure and was raised entirely by his mother, perhaps stunting his maturity as a result. Perhaps foolishly he associates bravado and aggressiveness with masculinity, leading to him to become a somewhat reckless warrior Prince.

Heroes.Name: Queen Rutela
Heroes.History: The former wife of King Zora De Bon XVI, Rutela eventually split from the Dominion and more or less formally sanctified Lanayru Province as a distinct nation. Prior to her marriage she was a general in the Dominion's army and had participated in the defense against Ganon's first invasion.

Heroes.Name: Sidon Dorephan
Heroes.History: The lone son of Duke Dorephan and younger brother of Mipha. Sidon has long been overshadowed by his sister despite his charisma and superior political mind. He is well liked by the nobles of both the Dominion and Lanayru, but behind his friendly and saavy words are the teeth of a shark. He is also rumored to have a strong rivalry with Prince Ralis, who is his direct superior and commander.

Heroes.Name: Titan: Vrylonacia, the Spirit of Lanayru
Heroes.History: An primordial Spirit from which Lanayru Province is named after, Vrylonacia was likely worshiped as a pagan deity by ancient Zora before the Akkalans arrived in the area and introduced worship of the Goddesses. Legend says that Vrylonacia fled the coast and into the south and slumbers somewhere beneath Hyrule's waters. While no longer active in the world, Vrylonacia's influence and symbols can be found throughout all of the Province's architecture and culture.

TeamBonuses.Name: International Banking
TeamBonuses.History: While Lanayru Province is very scrupulos with their money, they are not above sharing their wealth with their allies, especially if it helps Lanayru retain it's own wealth.
TeamBonuses.Description: Allies gain a slow trickle of metal.

Structures.Name: Wonder: Rutala Dam
Structures.History: This massive structure was built across the Airu River near its source in the Death Mountain range. It was able to regulate the flow of water through Lanayru Province as well as habor aquatic life in its reservoir.
